# JAPANKURU

> > JAPANKURU is a multilingual travel and culture guide to Japan, featuring Tokyo attractions, regional tourism, shopping guides, seasonal events, and authentic Japanese experiences.

JAPANKURU provides comprehensive travel content covering major destinations like Tokyo, Ueno, Asakusa, and regional areas including Tohoku, Kawasaki, and Hokkaido. The site offers practical guides for shopping districts, cultural experiences, accommodations, and seasonal activities, serving international travelers exploring Japan.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo attractions and neighborhoods
- Ueno and Ameyoko shopping district
- Asakusa cultural sites
- Seasonal events and festivals
- Regional Japan tourism (Tohoku, Kawasaki, Hokkaido)
- Shopping guides and specialty stores
- Japanese culture and traditions
- Projection mapping and digital art
- JAPAN RAIL CLUB membership
- Tokyo Tower and observation decks
- Akihabara anime and specialty shopping
- Temple and shrine visits
- Japanese cuisine and local food
- Studio Ghibli exhibitions
- Traditional Japanese gardens

- [Akihabara Shopping – Part 2: Serious Specialty Shopping](https://www.japankuru.com/en/shopping/e3651): Akihabara specialty shopping guide: anime merch, figures & gachapon
- [定番観光スポット　東京タワー](https://www.japankuru.com/ja/culture/e2797): Tokyo Tower guide: iconic observation deck, shopping & seasonal events

- [会津を旅する①会津若松の日本庭園、電車、グルメ体験](https://www.japankuru.com/ja/tour/e3323): Aizu-Wakamatsu travel: Japanese gardens, gastronomy train & tea ceremony
- [栃木で感じるフレッシュな冬：美味しく楽しく新たな体験が待っている４市町めぐり](https://www.japankuru.com/ja/tour/e3272): Tochigi winter travel: strawberry picking, pottery, onsen & wetlands
- [川崎市観光  グルメ・宿泊・ロマンチック夜景~東京郊外の旅 ~](https://www.japankuru.com/ja/tour/e2525): Kawasaki tourism: temples, shopping, night views & day trips from Tokyo
